coverage.requestLocalActor: Original HTTP context retained only in an unexported Session field; durable and wire JSON remain unchanged
coverage.authorityCancellation: Original cancellation/deadline errors survive single Authorize and browser identity verification, without being mapped to revocation or grant renewal
coverage.commit: Context/current actor/original device/scope/session expiry checked under original Social mutex before effects and again before persistence
coverage.rollback: Prepared contact/settings/invitation/relationship transaction is restored on failed final guard, including original receipts, notifications and audit entries
coverage.mountedHTTPRecovery: PUT settings cancelled during original body read after authorization returns 408 with unchanged state; a new request with the same effective session succeeds and original session is not revoked
coverage.deadlineAndSerialization: Elapsed request deadline rejected, JSON bytes identical with request context attached, no request context persisted
coverage.preparedEffectCancellation: Cancel during business effect preparation produces no request/notification/idempotency/audit state change

limitations: Mounted HTTP authority decisions use explicit software QA fixtures; not installed/public Wallet approval.
No cancelled consumed authorization proof is replayed within one request; a real SDK must produce its own fresh proof for a new request.
These commit guards do not claim completed cross-store Chat/Square effects or generic action proof nonce/uncertain-intent integration.
No shared reader is invoked under the owned transaction lock, no shared/module files or deployed Host/key/state changed.
Actual public and installed business, Matrix identities/HS mapping and real MONSTER validation remain required.
